strings.subtitle: — Mobebisi ya bafɛlɛ —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Bobombi mpe botiki ezali te. Salela butó ya nse.
strings.shred_button: B E B I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Likebisi! Na SSD nzela ya kokoma likolo ezali kolakisa te ete ebebisami mpo na TRIM.
Programɛ oyo ezali mpo na HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fɛlɛ "{name}" ekokomama likolo mpe elongolama.

Kokoba?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Mikɔlɔ ya nsango mosusu ya NTFS (ADS) esalemi te.
• Zulunalo USN epetolami te.
• Bakopi ya elili mpe bosangisi ya mapata
  (OneDrive mpe bongo) ezali na bopusi te.
strings.status_full: Makambo manzoto makomami mobimba na nzelo. Bozongisi ekoki te — bisaleli bikomonaka kaka nzelo.
strings.status_fast: Motó, mokila mpe milɔngɔ 4 MB makomami likolo. Oyo etikali ebangami te, kasi mpo na bipai, bozongisi mobimba na bisaleli ya batɛkɛ ezali te. Mpo na mikanda ya sekele salela lolenge MOBIMBA.
strings.status_empty: Fɛlɛ ezalaki mpamba, kokoma likolo esengelaki te. Elongolami.
strings.error_permission: Nakoki kozua fɛlɛ te. Ekoki kofungwama na programɛ mosusu. Kanga mpe meka lisusu.
strings.error_not_found: Fɛlɛ emonani te. Ekoki ete elongolamaki liboso.
strings.error_is_symlink: Oyo ezali likangá ya elembo. Bakangá bakoki kobebisama te — fɛlɛ ya mokano ekotikala malamu.
strings.error_reparse: Oyo ezali fɛlɛ ya esika (OneDrive to ndenge moko). Nsango na yango ezali na mapata, esi na disiki te — awa eloko ya kobebisa ezali te.
strings.error_not_file: Oyo ezali fɛlɛ te (dosie to eloko mosusu). Tika fɛlɛ.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fɛlɛ oyo ezali na bakangá ya makasi misusu ({n} mobimba). Bakangá ya makasi bazali na motó ya liboso te — bɛlɛ nkombo nyonso ekokani. Soki obebisi na nzela ya lelo, nsango ekokomama likolo mpe ekokatama tii 32 byte, kasi oyo etikali ekokoka kozuama na bakangá mosusu. Longola liboso bakangá nyonso.
strings.error_compressed:
Fɛlɛ ekangami, efungwamaki na sekele to ezali moke. Kokoma likolo na nzelo ezali kolakisa te ete nsango ya kala ebebisami mpo NTFS ebombaka yango na ndenge mosusu.

Longola elembo: finá na loboko ya mobali → Elembo → Likolo → longola elembo ya "Kokanga" mpe/to "Sekele". Sima salá SHREDDER lisusu.
